title: Oozy Silky Greek Rhubarb Saganaki
description: Rich and silky Greek dish featuring rhubarb, perfect for midnight cravings, this low-glycemic-friendly saganaki is a delightful treat. It combines the sweetness of rhubarb with the savory flavors of Greece.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the rhubarb, honey, olive oil, lemon juice, grated ginger, and cinnamon until the rhubarb is well coated.
Transfer the rhubarb mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 25 minutes, or until the rhubarb is tender.
While the rhubarb is baking, mix the Greek yogurt and sea salt in a small bowl.
After the rhubarb has finished baking, let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
To serve, place a portion of the warm rhubarb on a plate, top with a dollop of the yogurt mixture, and sprinkle with chopped walnuts.
Drizzle any remaining honey and lemon juice from the baking dish over the top of the saganaki.
